name: persist
description: Opt-in Stop hook that keeps the main agent working on a declared task until it is marked done. /persist starts, finishes, or cancels the loop; the hook blocks a stop only while a fresh, active, same-session state file exists, and fails open on context-limit stops, high transcript context, user aborts, auth errors, stale state, the iteration cap, a cancel signal, another session or project, re-entrancy, and any parse or IO error.
